weapon.d:
Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1).
At start of turn, if unit's Special cooldown count is at its maximum value, grants Special cooldown count-2 to unit; if unit's Special cooldown count is at its maximum value - 1, grants Special cooldown count-1 to unit.
At start of turn or after unit acts or triggers Canto, inflicts Spd/Def-7,【Exposure】, 【Spd Shackle】, and【Def Shackle】on closest foes and foes within 2 spaces of those foes through their next actions.
Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+X to unit (X = number of Bonus effects and Penalty effects active on unit × 2, excluding stat bonuses and stat penalties, + 10), unit deals +25 damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), reduces damage from foe's attacks by 15 (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from foe's Specials by an additional 15 during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
【Exposure】
Foe's attacks deal +10 damage.
【Spd Shackle】
Inflicts penalty on unit's Spd during combat = number of Penalty effects active on unit + 4, excluding stat penalties (max 8).
【Def Shackle】
Inflicts penalty on unit's Def during combat = number of Penalty effects active on unit + 4, excluding stat penalties (max 8).

assist.d: Target ally moves to opposite side of unit.

Moves target ally to opposite side of unit. Grants【Change of Fate】and【Dual Strike】to unit and target ally for 1 turn, grants Special cooldown count-1 to unit and target ally, and grants any Bonus active on unit to target ally, and any active on target ally to unit (once per turn; granted bonuses exclude stat bonuses inverted by Panic).
After Canto, if unit has used an Assist skill on the current turn, grants another action to unit, and re-enables Canto (once per turn; does not trigger when affected by effects of traps in Aether Raids during Canto).
Regarding【Dual Strike】granted to player army, the effect will now trigger even if the following condition is met: "if unit initiates combat and is within 2 spaces of an ally with Dual Strike (excluding unit)."
【Change of Fate】
Enables【Canto (２)】.
Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 to unit and unit deals damage = 3 × the total of the number of Bonus and Penalty effects active on unit, excluding stat bonuses and stat penalties, during combat (max 15; including area-of- effect Specials).
【Dual Strike】
If unit initiates combat and is adjacent to an ally with Dual Strike (excluding unit), unit attacks twice. (That turn only. Does not stack.)
【Canto (２)】
After an attack, Assist skill, or structure destruction, unit can move ２ space(s). (Once per turn. Only highest value applied. Does not stack.)

special.d: Before combat this unit initiates, foes in an area near target take damage equal to (unit's Atk minus foe's Def or Res).
Before combat this unit initiates, foes in an area near target take damage equal to 1.5 x (unit's Atk minus foe's Def or Res).

a.d: If attacking in Aether Raids, grants Atk/Def+X during combat. (Calculates X based on number of foe's defensive structures: ≤2 structures grants +4; 3 grants +3; 4 grants +2; ≥5 grants +1. Destroyed defensive structures are not counted.)

If attacking in Aether Raids, grants Atk/Def+X during combat. (Calculates X based on number of foe's defensive structures: ≤2 structures grants +7; 3 grants +5; 4 grants +3; ≥5 grants +1. Destroyed defensive structures are not counted.)

If attacking in Aether Raids, grants Atk/Def+X during combat. (Calculates X based on number of foe's defensive structures: ≤2 structures grants +10; 3 grants +7; 4 grants +4; ≥5 grants +1. Destroyed defensive structures are not counted.)

At start of turn, grants【Null Foresight Snare】 to unit for 1 turn.
If a Rally or movement Assist skill is used by unit or targets unit, grants【Null Foresight Snare】 to allies within 3 spaces of both unit and target ally or unit and targeting ally (including unit and that ally) after movement for 1 turn.
If unit initiates combat or is within 3 spaces of an ally, grants bonus to unit's Atk/Def = number of Bonus effects active on foe + 10 (max 14; excluding stat bonuses), unit deals +X damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), reduces damage from foe's first attack by X ("first attack" normally means only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit attacks twice," it means the first and second strikes; if Foresight Snare is active on foe, X = 15; otherwise, X = 7), and reduces the percentage of foe's non-Special "reduce damage by X%" skills by 50% during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
【Null Foresight Snare】
Neutralizes effects of foe's【Foresight Snare】.
【Foresight Snare】
If foe initiates combat and there were no combat instances on the current turn yet (player phase and enemy phase are counted separately), triggers the following effects:
- Cancels foe's attack, completing their action.
- Inflicts Isolation and status preventing counterattacks on foe through foe's next action.
- Cancels Foresight Snare granted to your army.
(These effects trigger after Aether Raids traps but before Savior; does not trigger in Pawns of Loki).

b.d: If unit’s HP ≤ 25% and unit initiates combat, unit can make a follow-up attack before foe can counterattack.
If unit’s HP ≤ 50% and unit initiates combat, unit can make a follow-up attack before foe can counterattack.
If unit’s HP ≤ 75% and unit initiates combat, unit can make a follow-up attack before foe can counterattack.

Inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-4 on foe, unit deals +X damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), reduces damage from foe's attacks by X (excluding area-of-effect Specials; X = 20% of the greater of unit's Spd or Def), and neutralizes effects that guarantee foe's follow-up attacks and effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks during combat. If unit initiates combat, unit can make a follow-up attack before foe's next attack.

c.d: At start of turn, grants Atk+2 to adjacent allies for 1 turn.
At start of turn, grants Atk+3 to adjacent allies for 1 turn.
At start of turn, grants Atk+4 to adjacent allies for 1 turn.

At start of turn, if unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Def+6 and “neutralizes foe’s bonuses during combat” to unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit for 1 turn.
Grants bonus to unit's Atk/Def = number of allies on the map with the "neutralizes foe's bonuses during combat" status effect active + 2 (excluding unit; max 5) and deals damage = number of spaces from start position to end position of whoever initiated combat × 2 during combat (max 8; excluding area-of-effect Specials).
